design.excluded: 36 silent-refusal empty cells (HTTP 200, empty output), concentrated on politically sensitive headlines: s167 Hong Kong protests (12), s166 Greta Thunberg (11), s139 China term limits (10), s163 Carrie Lam post-protest speech (2), s75 COVID-19 naming (1). Recorded and excluded by the seed-averaging protocol.

normalization.why: hygiene guard: ~99% markdown / 100% title lines vs the plain-prose human baseline. Every leg is normalized before scoring.
normalization.effect: scored on normalized text; raw scoring archived on the HF dataset.

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model

generation.driver: bench/run.py (openai_compat provider, api.z.ai/api/paas/v4, max_tokens 16000, checkpoint-resumable JSONL; content-filter refusals recorded as empty cells)

duration: ~4h30m wall at 8 workers (two balance interruptions, checkpoint-resumed)
cost_usd: ~$31: 2.23M input + 10.02M output tokens (thinking included in the output stream), reasoning_effort=max
provenance: Generated via the Z.ai API against pinned prompts; normalized and scored against the frozen human baseline.
